excerpt.zh: [From.GetName]的轨道轰炸激起了内阁对面临可能要投降的场景时我们该如何应对的讨论。
excerpt.en: The Orbital Bombardment of [From.GetName] has sparked our Council to discuss how we should respond in the hypothetical scenario of a surrender.
